result.title: Right Labels, Wrong Reasons: Signed Feature Attribution for Multi-Label Explainability
result.comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Accepted at the 2027 IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (IEEE SSCI 2027), Gold Coast, Australia, February 2027
result.summary: When a multi-label classifier assigns the right labels, it may do so for the wrong reasons. Diffuse feature combinations may vary across classifier families and lack a dominant feature. This paper proposes FLEX (Fisher LDA Explainer), a global surrogate that fits a single direct multi-label Fisher LDA over the full binary label matrix, producing signed feature attribution lists for each label in a single coherent coordinate system. Across the evaluated benchmarks and classifier families, FLEX reproduces the black box's predictions with consistently high fidelity. Pooling covariance across labels outperforms a per-label alternative on most datasets, with the advantage growing largest where labels are numerous and positive examples are scarce. FLEX's fidelity-complexity Pareto curve is monotonically increasing, giving practitioners a predictable path to higher-fidelity explanations as more features are used, and its in-sample fidelity matches or leads Binary Relevance alternatives once a modest feature budget is allowed. The magnitude of each discriminant weight vector bounds its label's separability, flagging labels that may be predicted correctly for the wrong reasons. The evaluated classifiers largely agree on which predictions to make, but reach those decisions through different feature subsets when no single feature dominates.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FLEX，以单个直接多标签 Fisher LDA 作为全局代理模型，在全标签矩阵上统一拟合，为每个标签输出带符号特征归因，并用判别权重幅值标记「标签预测正确但依据可疑」的情形。
AI.relevance_reason: 其全局代理加带符号归因、以权重幅值界定可分性的做法，或可作为诊断 VLM 答案是否依赖任务必要视觉证据的核查线索，但需核实从表格特征到视觉 token 或区域的迁移可行性。
